newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan MOF to issue statement on Daiwa Bank.
newsitem.headline: Japan MOF to issue statement on Daiwa Bank.

text.p: Japan's Finance Ministry will issue a statement at 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) concerning its order last year to Daiwa Bank Ltd to improve its business after revelations that a former executive at the bank's New York branch made huge losses on unauthorised bond transactions, a ministry official said.
"It will not be a new order, but recently the ministry inspected Daiwa, and it will announce its decision on what to do concerning last year's order based on that," the official said.

In February, Daiwa Bank pleaded guilty to charges of concealing its $1.1 billion loss and agreed to pay $340 million in fines, the largest criminal fine ever levied against a financial institution in the United States.
The charges stemmed from the conduct of its top management during the summer of 1995, when managers covered up the huge trading losses at the New York branch.
In November 1995, U.S. regulatory authorities ordered Daiwa to close its operations in the U.S. and instigated the lawsuits which resulted in Daiwa's guilty plea and fine.
